scripts.build: wrangler types && vite build && node scripts/wrap-worker.mjs

DB.description: The D1 database that holds every contact, campaign, automation and setting. Keep the suggested name or pick your own; the first build applies its migrations.

MEDIA.description: The R2 bucket for uploaded images, logos and the nightly backups. Keep the suggested name or pick your own.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Make up a long phrase and keep it. When you first open the app, /setup asks for it before it creates your admin account. Every other secret is generated by the deploy.
